card: Updates the Guix time-machine pinned commit to a newer upstream revision and adjusts build manifests across deterministic release builds. It switches to CMake 4.3.3 with CMAKE_LINK_WARNING_AS_ERROR, updates python-lief to 1.0.0, reverts osslsigncode to upstream Guix, and disables fixincludes on cross-gcc. This refreshes release build dependencies and makes GCC 16 and Clang 22/23 available in Guix.
changed_since_previous: Rebased after related changes split out into PRs #35869 and #35870 were merged.
evidence: PR description notes upgrades: cmake 3.31.10 to 4.3.3, linux-libre-headers to 6.1.187, python-lief to 1.0.0, and availability of Clang 22/23 and GCC 16.
Commit c3e787947f fixes a deprecation warning: manifest_build.scm:279:8: warning: 'ninja' is deprecated, use '(@ (gnu packages build-tools) ninja)' instead.
problem: The pinned Guix environment lacks newer upstream toolchain releases (GCC 16, Clang 22/23), runs older build tools (CMake 3.x), emits deprecation warnings on module imports, and retains packaging overrides like osslsigncode that upstream Guix now provides natively.

risk.why: Mistakes in Guix environment scripts or compiler flags could break release build determinism or produce miscompiled release binaries.

scope_notes: Touches only contrib/guix and ci/lint/requirements.txt. Modifies deterministic release build environment specifications.
summary: Updates the Guix time-machine pinned commit to a newer upstream revision and adjusts build manifests for package recipe changes. It switches the build environment to CMake 4.3.3 using CMAKE_LINK_WARNING_AS_ERROR, updates python-lief to 1.0.0, drops an in-tree osslsigncode definition in favor of upstream Guix, updates the deprecated Ninja module import, and disables fixincludes on gcc-sans-libc.
